Builds and configures the Firedancer tile topology, links, CPU affinity, and tile settings.

# Purpose
This C file builds and configures the Firedancer topology from the runtime configuration. It creates the shared-memory workspaces, links, and tiles for the main processing pipeline, including `net`, `quic`, `verify`, `dedup`, `resolv`, `pack`, `bank`, `poh`, `shred`, `store`, `sign`, `metric`, and `cswtch`. It also adds optional parts of the topology when enabled, such as the `plugin` and `gui` tiles, and the bundle-related tiles and links. The code sets link sizes, message types, reliability mode, polling mode, and tile counts so the topology matches the configured system layout.

The file also assigns CPU affinity and checks that the configured CPU lists match the number of tiles and available CPUs. It handles special shared objects such as `bank_busy` and `poh_shred`, which are used for coordination between tiles. The [`fd_topo_configure_tile`](<#fd_topo_configure_tile>) function then fills each tile with its tile-specific settings, such as ports, buffer sizes, key paths, bundle addresses, Prometheus settings, and GUI settings. This file acts as the main topology setup and tile configuration code for the Firedancer process.
